purpose: Define platform-agnostic ingestion and reconciliation between live/public sources and historical backup exports while preserving governed Scope authority.
principles: Platform is a source adapter, not the LOC data model.
Live/public sources and backup exports coexist; neither replaces the other.
Live/public sources provide freshness, current metadata and presentation URLs.
Backup exports provide historical completeness, recovery evidence and content that may no longer have a public URL.
After reconciliation, governed Scope registries remain authoritative; generated/Search/RAG/UI projections do not become authority.
A connector failure may delay the next sync but must not break API search or existing governed data.
Candidate or calculated URLs are never promoted as canonical permalinks without observed or verified source evidence.

suno.rule: Only author-public songs are eligible for live ingestion and analysis. Private, unlisted, draft or otherwise non-public songs are excluded from analysis by default.
suno.reason: Non-public status is an author decision and must not be overridden by automated ingestion.

default.rule: Only public content or author-approved content may be promoted from a live source into public/searchable projections. Backup evidence may remain private or non-searchable.

url_policy.runtime: APIs return stored canonical URLs; they do not call external platforms during a search request

reconciliation.ambiguous: keep unresolved and require additional evidence
never_infer: public permalink from an unrelated export asset id
song/media relation from a shared date alone

adapter_contract.note: Adapters may expose platform-specific metadata; downstream authority is determined by the governed Scope, while content capabilities are Feature assignments.

implementation.rule: The reconciliation script emits an evidence report only and never mutates governed registries automatically.

historical_boundary: Historical LOC1–8 routing may remain in old source evidence only; new reconciliation uses Scope authority plus Feature assignment.
